title: Update 19.0
cats: Articles using infobox templates with no data rows
html:
Update 19.0, previously named update 0.19.0, deployed on the 16th of March 2025, added various new features, including the SAM and the replay system.

New Features

  • SAM (Surface-to-Air Missile System). This new building has the ability to shoot down nearby missiles.
  • New Map: Britannia
  • Games can now be replayed after they've ended, simply by following the openfront.io/join/id link.
  • The game will now alert the player if they are desynced.
  • There is now a maximum player count per map:
    • Small Maps (e.g. Europe): 60 players
    • Medium Maps: 70 players
    • Large Maps (e.g. World): 150 players

Balancing Changes

  • Increased trade opportunities when global port count is low.
  • It is now easier to attack irradiated land (nuclear wasteland) when 70% of the map is nuked.
  • Reduced bonus advantages for larger nations.

AI Improvements

  • Improved embargo handling by NPC nations.
  • NPCs will now embargo enemy nations.
  • NPC relations will deteriorate if the player places them under embargo.

List of Contributors

Thanks to everyone that contributed to this new version!

  • Readixyee
  • TigerMcSwane
  • RespectfulPengin
